limits: The consumed products are simplified ADM2 sources labeled 2007/2018 and are not exact physical shorelines or boundary authority.
Area measures are unprojected square degrees.
Overlay intersections cannot distinguish source-processing error from historical water, ice, or authoritative boundary placement.
No geometry assignment, repair, or legal conclusion is made.

method.area_units: square degrees; not suitable as physical area
method.dimensions: positive area means polygonal intersection; line/point dimensions retained per hit
method.overlay: Shapely GEOS predicates/intersections and unary union on unmodified EPSG:4326 coordinates
